634:t_1:86.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Major $$グラハム$$... You are...」

634:t_1:87.en:
$$グラハム$$
「...I have been ashamed of myself until today... And the result is that I can finally speak to him, and in a situation like this, no less.」

634:t_1:88.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But I do not consider the days until now wasted. At last I understand what I must do.」

634:t_1:90.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I am a man who once repeated foolish acts in trying to surpass the $$ガンダム$$.」

634:t_1:91.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But that idea was mistaken after all. What I must surpass is this boy.」

634:t_1:92.en:
$$フェルト$$
(So $$刹那$$ being here changed the Major...)

634:t_1:93.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I am going. Stay with him for me.」

634:t_1:99.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「...$$イアン$$, $$リンダ$$. All the adjustments to $$クアンタ$$ are complete.」

634:t_1:100.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So it is finally finished, in the true sense.」

634:t_1:101.en:
$$イアン$$
「Sharing consciousness through $$脳量子波$$ in a high-density particle region, and linking people's feelings across the battlefield...」

634:t_1:102.en:
$$リンダ$$
「A machine built to make people stop fighting...」

634:t_1:103.en:
$$イアン$$
「That is the $$ガンダム$$ $$刹那$$ wished for... $$クアンタ$$.」

634:t_1:104.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So showing the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ with this machine that we bear them no hostility is the hope left to humanity, right?」

634:t_1:105.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are huge in number. In a war of force against force, humanity will run out of strength sooner or later...」

634:t_1:106.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But with $$刹那$$, the one who matters most, in that shape...」

634:t_1:107.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$アレルヤ$$... Can't you pilot this thing?」

634:t_1:108.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「With $$脳量子波$$ at the level that $$マリー$$ and I have, we can't bring out the true worth of $$クアンタ$$.」

634:t_1:109.en:
$$マリー$$
「This machine is for $$イノベイター$$s, after all.」

634:t_1:110.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then what about $$ガンダム$$ Senpai, or $$カミーユ$$ and $$バナージ$$...」

634:t_1:111.en:
$$イアン$$
「It's true we could clear the problem of the sheer amount of psychic waves, but...」

634:t_1:114.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It is the difference in traits between $$ニュータイプ$$s and $$イノベイター$$s.」

634:t_1:115.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I figured they were about the same, in that both give off psychic waves, but...」

634:t_1:116.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「So those two really are different?」

634:t_1:117.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This is only my own opinion, but $$イノベイター$$s exist within the larger category of $$ニュータイプ$$s.」

634:t_1:118.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You mean $$刹那$$ is a $$ニュータイプ$$ too?」

634:t_1:119.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If he had been born in the $$宇宙世紀$$ world, he would have awakened as a $$ニュータイプ$$ just as he was.」

634:t_1:120.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But $$刹那$$ was born in the $$ＡＤＷ$$ and was influenced by GN Particles.」

634:t_1:121.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You mean the presence of GN Particles is what decides the difference between $$ニュータイプ$$s and $$イノベイター$$s?」

634:t_1:122.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Exactly. $$刹那$$... $$イノベイター$$s have the power to expand their own consciousness using GN Particles as a medium.」

634:t_1:123.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Unlike $$ニュータイプ$$s, who use psychic waves to reach a specific person, the defining trait of $$イノベイター$$s is a broader sharing of consciousness that doesn't pick its partner.」

634:t_1:125.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Right. This must be for the sake of what $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ aimed for.」

634:t_1:126.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I think he sought a power that would allow the humans of a new era, born someday, to share consciousness in a more universal way.」

634:t_1:127.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't tell me he was thinking of the time we'd run into something like the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$?」

634:t_1:129.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リボンズ$$, who knew of $$イオリア$$'s plan, seems to have been interested in communicating with beings whose words don't get through... with another species.」

634:t_1:130.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Did $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ foresee even the arrival of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...」

634:t_1:131.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Not quite like that. ...I just think he was anticipating that a situation like this would come about when humanity someday advanced into space.」

634:t_1:132.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So $$イノベイター$$s are the power meant for that time.」

634:t_1:133.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That is only my guess, though.」

634:t_1:134.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But between humans, we can come to understand each other by using every word we have, without psychic waves. I don't think my guess is far off.」

634:t_1:135.en:
$$イアン$$
「So $$刹那$$ advanced to a new stage following $$イオリア$$'s plan...」

634:t_1:136.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not only the effect of the GN Particles. The fact that he is a lonely guy is part of the reason too, I think.」

634:t_1:138.en:
$$バナージ$$
「He doesn't seem like it, though...」

634:t_1:139.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「No... That's not quite right, believe me.」

634:t_1:140.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Yeah... I understand what Captain $$アムロ$$ is trying to say.」

634:t_1:141.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Maybe that's exactly why the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ were drawn to him, being who $$刹那$$ is.」

634:t_1:142.en:
$$アムロ$$
(That's right, $$刹那$$... Only you, who have always sought to understand others, can accomplish this mission.)

634:t_1:143.en:
$$アムロ$$
(So I'm waiting. For you to get into this $$クアンタ$$.)

634:t_1:147.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's not it, is it?」

634:t_1:148.en:
$$グラハム$$
「So it's Happy $$コーラサワー$$, is it?」

634:t_1:149.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「This time I'm going with Immortal $$コーラサワー$$.」

634:t_1:150.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「How about it, $$グラハム・エーカー$$? Team up with me and you get a share of my immortality.」

634:t_1:151.en:
$$グラハム$$
「You saw right through me, did you...」

634:t_1:152.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「'Bushido means dying' and whatever, right? That's out of style these days.」

634:t_1:153.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Atoning for the past or whatever, I don't know, but if two guys with that kind of mindset stick together, you won't make it back.」

634:t_1:154.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「So you saw through even me.」

634:t_1:155.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Exactly. If you're picking a partner, pick me. Then you'll lose any urge to treat your life cheaply.」

634:t_1:156.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I appreciate the sentiment, but...」

634:t_1:157.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You value your own life cheaply, huh...」

634:t_1:159.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But no life is cheaper than mine.」

634:t_2:4.en:
$$刹那$$
(The sorrow... the pain, the suffering...! This is... the feelings of everyone on this battlefield...!)

634:t_2:8.en:
$$リヒティ$$
(Everybody's still fighting desperately to live, you know.)

634:t_2:9.en:
$$クリス$$
(They're trying to change the world.)

634:t_2:10.en:
$$刹那$$
($$リヒテンダール$$, $$クリスティナ$$...)

リヒテンダール.evidence: Given-name form of リヒテンダール・ツエーリ (Lichtendahl Tsery, glossary); Setsuna says it in full in 634:t_2:10 (Lichty is the nickname).

クリスティナ.evidence: Given-name form of クリスティナ・シエラ (Christina Sierra, glossary); Setsuna says it in full in 634:t_2:10 (Chris is the nickname).
